svg.title: A 50 km zone would cover 95% of Hawaii's land, and a 25 km zone 70%

cc:Work.dc:title: A 50 km zone would cover 95% of Hawaii's land, and a 25 km zone 70%
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the main Hawaiian Islands with land shaded by zone: the 25 km zone covers 70% of the land, the 50 km zone 95%, and the 100 km zone all of it. The interior of the Big Island and parts of Maui fall outside 25 km.
